description.p: ShimeLinux is a Linux port of Shimeji-ee desktop pet, an application that lets you have little characters (called Shimeji) walking around on your screen.

ul.li: It is compatible with any Shimeji made for the latest version of Shimeji-ee
It works on many Linux desktop environments and tiling window managers
It supports interactive windows on KDE Plasma

screenshot.caption: A couple of Shimeji climbing on the settings window

ul.li: Added a button in the environment tab that shows a description of the current environment.
Improved the settings menu layout.
Fixed issues with the system tray icon on the Flatpak app.
Fixed a bug where Shimeji could not play sounds on the Flatpak app.
Fixed a bug where the Wayland environment would be enabled by default on X11 tiling window managers.
Fixed a bug where thrown windows would keep moving after restoring them on the KDE environment.
The windowed environment window will now be centered.
The Wayland environment is now disabled on unsupported operating systems and on the Flatpak app (except on KDE).
Shimeji are now displayed on native Wayland surfaces on KDE Plasma. This can be disabled in the Environment tab in settings.
You can now set which layer Shimeji will be displayed on in the Environment tab when using the Wayland or KDE environment.
The Wayland environment now supports the Mango compositor.
Fixed a bug where Shimeji would keep falling over while trying to move a window.
Fixed a bug where the cursor position would be slightly off when using the windowed environment.
Fixed several bugs with popup menus in the Wayland environment.
Shimeji will now be paused when the settings menu and image set chooser are open.
The Wayland environment can no longer be enabled on GNOME and Cinnamon.
There will no longer be an error message every time the program starts if the system tray icon cannot be created.
Reduced memory usage by about 40%.
Fixed a bug where custom behavior names in the "Set Behavior" popup and "Reveal Statistics" window would not have spaces between words.
Fixed a bug where the path to the actions.xml and behaviors.xml files would be displayed incorrectly in the Shimeji chooser if a directory other than ~/.config/shimelinux was used.
Added better error messages for common errors in the Wayland environment.
Removed the "Menu Scaling" setting and the buttons in the "About" tab in settings as they did not work properly.
